title: Code walkthrough
description: walkthrough.json inside <walkthroughs-folder>/<walkthrough-id>/, next to one <slide-id>.mp3 per slide.

id.description: Hyphen-separated name; must equal the folder name.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the walkthrough list.

commit.description: Full SHA every link is pinned to, so the walkthrough never drifts from the code.

targetMinutes.description: Length the author was asked for.

id.description: Unique within the walkthrough; prefix with the slide number (01-overview) so files sort.

narration.description: What the audio says, written to be spoken.

file.description: Repo-relative path to open. Omit for a slide with no code.

audio.description: MP3 file name in the same folder; written by generate-audio.ts.

durationSec.description: Audio length at 1x; written by generate-audio.ts.
